Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring that antifreeze be made unpalatable to humans and animals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to placing aversive agents in antifreeze; andadding a new section to chapter 70.106 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.106 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any antifreeze product containing by weight ten percent or moreethylene glycol and manufactured in this state on or after July 1,2004, or sold in this state on or after July 1, 2005, must also containan aversive agent, approved by the director, in a concentrationsufficient to render that antifreeze product unpalatable to humans andanimals. However, this section does not apply to the following: (a) The sale of a motor vehicle that contains an antifreezeproduct; (b) Used antifreeze products; (c) Recycled antifreeze products installed by an auto repair firm;or (d) Wholesale containers of antifreeze containing fiftyfivegallons or more of an antifreeze product. p. 1 SSB 5724 (2) If the director finds or has probable cause to believe that anyantifreeze product being sold in this state fails to comply withsubsection (1) of this section, the director is authorized to orderthat product's removal from retail shelf space.
